We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Likely need to get 1H NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return spectra for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration corresponds to 3H each. But we only have textual spectra maybe with integration. We need to parse.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
